Data:Slnev.morgen.zachary.json.startdescription: After their conversation on containment-in-glass last time, Morgen and Zachary have brought each other exhibits - or gifts. For her, a blued glass mirror that's always cold to the touch; for him, a glass key that she suggests he crush if things become 'too much what they are.' [Lesson: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]

Data:Slnev.olympe.agdistis.json.startdescription: Olympe has become interested in an 'demi-dyad' - a supposed partway Edge-long who attempted to ascend under the Horned-Axe, a habitué of the now-defunct Ecdysis Club where Agdistis once worked. Agdistis suggests she cease her investigations: that it is not wise to pursue any implication that the Horned-Axe may still possess any trace of Edge... [Lesson: Edicts Liminal]

Data:Slnev.olympe.aladim.json.startdescription: Olympe shows al-Adim sketches she's made based on signs she saw in a dream. 'Yes,' he says, 'this is almost Sabazine. Here. The Towers of the Little Hammer. The Wolf-Wife. The Black Dove. I think you dreamt that you were coming to Brancrug…' [Lesson: Sabazine]

Data:Slnev.olympe.arthur.json.startdescription: Olympe is interested in a Ramsund-inscribed altar to the Beach-Crow that Arthur found in a cliff-grotto near Trebizond. He sketches some of the signs for her.  [Lesson: Ramsund]

Data:Slnev.olympe.arun.json.startdescription: Olympe and Arun chuckle over a Roost-rumour that's recently resurfaced, of ancient trysts between the Malachite and the Mare-in-the-Tree; they speak of the tradition that the Mare-in-the-Tree can sometimes be the Witch's Sister, what that might mean, and especially what that might mean for Rowena and Aunt Mopsy. [Lesson: Transformations & Liberations]

Data:Slnev.olympe.azita.json.startdescription: Olympe tries to interrogate Azita on her alleged provision of weapons to various rebel and partisan groups east of the Black Sea. Azita insists that her dyad-twin Mehrad is the one responsible. [Lesson: Edicts Martial]

Data:Slnev.olympe.chaima.json.startdescription: Olympe teaches Chaima a few useful Ramsund phrases, on condition that Chaima never uses them to deceive her prey. [Lesson: Ramsund]

Data:Slnev.olympe.connie.json.startdescription: Olympe insists to Connie that she has never breached oneiric law in her use of exotic pigments in her work. Connie is certain that Olympe has used refulgin; Olympe admits she has, but assures Connie that it was diluted beyond the hazard-point… [Lesson: Inks of Revelation]

Data:Slnev.olympe.coquille.json.startdescription: Olympe is writing a novel where one of the characters is an architect specialising in secret passages and concealed entrances. She's hoping Coquille can help with her research. Coquille is understandably suspicious, although Olympe promises up and down that any difficult details will be in strict confidence. Eventually Olympe explains that the protagonist is based on Fraser, and Coquille relaxes enough to share her secrets. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.olympe.corso.json.startdescription: Olympe and Corso commiserate about the difficulty of getting the ink asimel out of one's dreams, grumbling that one's sleep stays silver for months… [Lesson: Inks of Revelation]

Data:Slnev.olympe.dagmar.json.startdescription: Olympe and Dagmar compare their experiences of getting drunk on Skinshuck Mead. Both wonder whether they really changed shape, or whether their spirits walked in the beast-shape; both agree that they'll only drink the stuff again in trustworthy company. [Lesson: Solutions & Separations]

Data:Slnev.olympe.douglas.json.startdescription: Olympe is probing Douglas about the suppression of Verro's work 'Opening the Sky' - about how odd it is that the government would commission the work for  the New King's coronation, and then suppress it. Douglas puffs uncomfortably on his pipe and says things like 'police business' and 'don't know much about music'; until Olympe mentions the word 'Gleam', at which point he abruptly excuses himself and goes out to take the air. [Lesson: Ouranoscopy]

Data:Slnev.olympe.ehsan.json.startdescription: Ehsan longingly, regretfully describes the jewels he knew in the earth, in his skaptodon years, as he perceived them through slower, stronger senses. (Olympe: 'How long were you in the earth?' Ehsan: 'That's the Lionsmith's secret.') [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.olympe.fraser.json.startdescription: Olympe is writing a novel where one of the characters owns a mining firm, and she's hoping Fraser can help with her research. Fraser is desperately concerned about unnecessary publicity, although Olympe promises him that the character will not share his name, his appearance, or any of his biographical details. He does grudgingly agree to help out when Olympe confides that the protagonist is based on Azita. [Lesson: Coil & Chasm]

Data:Slnev.olympe.hokobald.json.startdescription: Olympe and Hokobald exchange elliptical observations about lymph, wine, choroid, and chitin. She pats his hand and smiles; he shrugs his vast shoulders. [Lesson: Resurgences & Emergences]

Data:Slnev.olympe.morgen.json.startdescription: Olympe asks frankly if Morgen wished to become alukite, and if not, whether there are any steps she might have taken to avoid conception. Morgen shivers with amusement - is it only amusement? - and observes that Olympe never did understand the Grail; that it's no wonder Olympe 'chose another path.' [Lesson: Resurgences & Emergences]

Data:Slnev.olympe.serena.json.startdescription: Olympe has been researching the Obliviates - their old places of power, their words of chaining. Serena is very interested in her findings. [Lesson: Sacra Limiae]

Data:Slnev.olympe.stanislav.json.startdescription: Olympe asks Stanislav about the 'Pontine Yew' of legend; and then about the honey of its flowers, which opens a door to another place. He has tasted the honey, but he will say of that place only that it is not the Mansus. [Lesson: Rites of the Roots]

Data:Slnev.olympe.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Olympe chats to Denzil about her travels in Europe. From time to time Denzil says something. Usually what he says is 'Be that so?', but once he observes, gnomically, 'Wonder.' [Lesson: Path & Pilgrim]

Data:Slnev.olympe.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Last time, Olympe lent Mr Kille her copy of Coward's 'Mrs Worthington'. He now returns it with thanks. They enthuse over the piece for some minutes, after which she smilingly presents him with two tickets for a Coward performance in London next month. Suddenly serious, he declines, with thanks. She insists that they're comps, and cost her nothing; he says very quietly that he has learnt that it can be unwise to accept gifts from visitors to Hush House. Olympe's smile flickers; she withdraws the tickets; the conversation is at an end. [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Slnev.olympe.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Timothy is delighted to hear that Olympe knows Georgia. He has literally hundreds of questions, he assures her, about the wine, the heterodoxies, the Panther's Skin, the Fifth Cup, the myth of the Amiranis Beteli… Olympe massages her temples and tells him that he's allowed ten questions. She does, however, answer each of them in detail. [Lesson: Sand Stories]

Data:Slnev.olympe.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette wonders whether the gods-who-were-stone can be resolved to psychic or psychological factors - to what degree they were ever real Hours at all, rather than baser, part-sublimated impulses of the existing Hours. Olympe is intrigued. [Lesson: Putrefactions & Calcinations]

Data:Slnev.olympe.zachary.json.startdescription: Zachary is having a bad day. His eyes are wide and staring; his teeth chatter. Olympe lays a hand on his arm to comfort him, and quotes from the Debate of Seven Cups: 'Sorrow then is Sense's final Solvent…' [Lesson: Solutions & Separations]

Data:Slnev.serena.agdistis.json.startdescription: Serena and Agdistis discuss the rites of the Damascene branch of the House of Lethe. She wonders - she is tactful, but the implication is clear - whether Agdistis participated in any similar rites to preserve his wonderful voice. He says that he did not, and he is smiling, but it is a smiling mask. [Lesson: Sacra Limiae]

Data:Slnev.serena.aladim.json.startdescription: Serena quizzes al-Adim about the Damascene branch of the organisation now called the Obliviates. He shares what he remembers. [Lesson: Sacra Limiae]

Data:Slnev.serena.arthur.json.startdescription: Serena and Arthur discuss the Red Flower of the Watchman's Tree in hushed voices. Serena recalls ways that the Serapeum has used the ithast's arts to preserve knowledge even in a book that is burnt... [Lesson: Pyroglyphics]

Data:Slnev.serena.arun.json.startdescription: Serena and Arun debate the best - and the safest - lighting conditions in which to read texts recorded in Inks of Revelation. [Lesson: Inks of Revelation]

Data:Slnev.serena.azita.json.startdescription: Serena and Azita discuss the exploits and the disappearance of the Diarist, the Lantern-long who as a mortal was named Lars Westergren. 'He was a monster,' Serena acknowledges, 'but he was our monster.' [Lesson: Watchman's Paradoxes]

Data:Slnev.serena.chaima.json.startdescription: Serena and Chaima have both undergone the process known as Torgue's Cleansing. Serena describes it as 'horrible'. Chaima suggests instead that it is 'bracing.' [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.serena.connie.json.startdescription: Connie and Serena worriedly discuss recent developments in Britain and the Continent where the restrictions of the Duties have been set aside by governments seeking ever more terrible weapons… [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]

Data:Slnev.serena.coquille.json.startdescription: There is a tradition that each century in the Mansus is a new feasting-hall for the Hours, and that at a century's end, they shut it up and move to a new one… but because each hall is sealed by the combined authority of all the Hours, it's impossible to prove. Coquille and Serena share their calculations on where in the solar calendar a Mansus-century's end might fall. Both agree, to their clear disquiet, that it would most likely occur in the next few years. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.serena.corso.json.startdescription: Serena wants to contract Corso to obtain for her a long-rumoured volume of Kalle's poetry - supposedly a development of the themes in 'The Sky, the Soul' - for reasons she is unwilling to share. They discuss its likely location and contents, and Corso warns her that it may not in fact exist, but happily accepts an advance payment anyway. [Lesson: Pyroglyphics]

Data:Slnev.serena.dagmar.json.startdescription: Serena and Dagmar discuss the relationship between the Bounds, the Moon-Marches, and Nowhere. Serena considers Nowhere and the space beyond the Moon-Marches to be contiguous, but Dagmar shakes her head firmly. 'Ys never could find a way into Nowhere. And no Star ever found a way back.' [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.serena.douglas.json.startdescription: Serena and Douglas have discovered a shared passion for knitting: they show each other examples of their work. Douglas says absent-mindedly, ' There is a prophecy among weavers of one who unwisely seeks to find the future…' Serena recoils in surprise, and Douglas grumbles: 'No-one ever thinks I've read a bleedin' book.' [Lesson: Weaving & Knotworking]

Data:Slnev.serena.ehsan.json.startdescription: Serena and Ehsan speak of the 'shrouded rites' of the Church Solar - the ones forbidden to the public, who still largely think of the Hours as fables or god-masks. [Lesson: Sacra Solis Invicti]

Data:Slnev.serena.fraser.json.startdescription: Serena and Fraser speculate about bisclavrets, the werewolves of Broceliande. Serena proposes connections both to Ys and to families like the Ravelines who labour under a beast-curse. She cuts Fraser's response off impatiently: 'Not everything has to be about the Carapace Cross, you know.' [Lesson: Coil & Chasm]

Data:Slnev.serena.hokobald.json.startdescription: Serena and Hokobald are arguing, again, about the final nature and identity of a coming Hour. 'The Chandler,' Hokobald insists impatiently, 'leaves the House without entering it. And now, quite clearly, she is scrining again, without any kind of ascension that I can see.' Serena shakes her head: 'No. She has not achieved power of that magnitude. And in any case: I will simply not believe it of her.' Hokobald only growls, savagely: 'Then you are still a fool.' [Lesson: Transformations & Liberations]

Data:Slnev.serena.morgen.json.startdescription: Serena suggests some avenues of research that might - just might - allow an alukite to shake off their taint, or to slake their driving hunger… but Morgen insists, perhaps too fervently, that no Ligeian would ever be interested in anything like that. [Lesson: Meniscate Reflections]

Data:Slnev.serena.olympe.json.startdescription: Serena and Olympe compare their experiences of King Crucible. Serena has summoned him on several occasions. Olympe has interviewed him, to Serena's surprise: even Crucible is increasingly inclined, it seems, to walk in human shape… [Lesson: Transformations & Liberations]

Data:Slnev.serena.stanislav.json.startdescription: Serena speaks didactically about the 'frangible consequences' of Fucine in the whispered prayers of surgeons. 'Very much not my speciality. But the Serapeum has hosted some august physicians over the years.' [Lesson: Fucine]
